args.title: July 2023 decision rights — Helio Start and retained-mid expansion
args.body:
Period-specific historical record — July 2023. This note describes the operating split used during July 2023 and is not current organizational policy.

Scope
- Helio Start: guarded pre-discovery for under-50-seat opportunities; no beta, pricing-page experiment, or launch implication until the relevant gates cleared.
- Retained-mid expansion: behavior-based Expansion Assist exploration for retained mid-segment v2 paid accounts with 75–200 seats; separate from Helio Start and not treated as forecast or QBR revenue evidence.

Strategic decision lane
Riley retained decision rules, executive tradeoffs, cross-functional guardrails, final claims, and language used for leadership or board-facing communication. This included deciding whether evidence could unlock a gate, setting refusal and eligibility boundaries, keeping the workstreams analytically separate, and preventing exploratory findings from being presented as commitments or revenue proof.

Routine execution lanes
- Owen owned first-pass baseline/readout shapes, source-completeness and candidate-field cuts for Helio Start, and eligibility and measurement cuts for retained-mid Expansion Assist. His outputs were expected to identify samples, caveats, and unusable evidence.
- Ines owned the Helio Start lifecycle-fork risk map and copy boundaries, plus reusable copy learning for Expansion Assist. State-changing lifecycle work remained out of scope until gates cleared.
- Daniela owned instrumentation and taxonomy follow-through, source reliability, and engineering release control, including event definitions and QA needed for measurement and entitlement/support checks.
- Priya coordinated the operating-note and owner-lane framing; the July split was an informal working arrangement, not a permanent org chart or formal company process.

Decision boundary
Routine owners could prepare analyses, maps, copy guidance, instrumentation, and readiness evidence within their lanes. Riley made the consequential calls on eligibility/refusal rules, gate movement, cross-workstream boundaries, and executive interpretation. Helio Start discovery inputs did not establish beta readiness; Expansion Assist exploration did not establish rollout success, pipeline credit, or forecastable revenue.
